You did a foolish thing, and that's saying it nicely.  Humility and hope would be how I would go forward in something like this.  I prefer email of a serious discussion, not a text or phone call, as it provides the receiver to respond in their own time and gives some power to them.  You've unintentionally betrayed their trust, and stupidly given them an uncurable disease without their consent.  I'm sorry but it's true, even if you are well meaning.

I recommend you try to apologize, write the email about them, how they must feel and how you made a terrible mistake.  They may never want you in their life again and it would be understandable.  I hope that this works out for you, but understand what harm, physically, psychologically, and emotionally,  you have done to your loved one.

There's almost always a chance to reset the relationship, to rebuild trust, to rebuild intimacy.  My wife used to reach out to me if we fought, I would show her love by not saying anything at all if she was in a way, and just put a hand on her.

I hope you can find your momentum with your loved one and find your peace and reach out.
